---
name: Out of Logic Bug Reports
about: Reached a check that was out of logic? Make sure this area is listed as mapped
  on the README.
title: "[Bug] - Out of Logic - AP LOCATION NAME"
labels: bug, low-priority
assignees: ''
type: Bug

---

**What version are you on?**
Version: v0.X.Xx

**What Room ID / Name does this apply to?**
Room IDs can be retrieved from several mods, MapWarp is an example.
Room names and logic can be retrieved from [here](https://github.com/zerounit-dev/silksong-rando-ap-logic).

**Is this a Skip?**
Did getting to this check out of logic require an unconventional route or skip?

**Explanation**
What is the actual issue and how do we recreate it?

**Inventory List**
What does your current movement inventory look like that helped you break the requirement?

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem. UT images using /get_logical_path are immensely helpful for diagnosing these issues, it can be acquired [here](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases/latest).
